title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Fevers and shortness of breath for the past three days.

History of Present Illness
The patient presents with a three-day history of subjective fevers, associated with chills and increasing dyspnea, particularly with exertion. He reports waking up feeling short of breath upon waking. Denies chest pain or palpitations. He states the shortness of breath is worse when climbing stairs.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10 mg daily
Furosemide 40 mg daily
Aspirin 81 mg daily

Exam
Vitals: T 101.2°F, HR 98, BP 130/78, RR 22. Lungs reveal bilateral crackles in the lower lobes. Heart sounds reveal a rhythmic S3 gallop. No peripheral edema noted today.

Assessment
Acute exacerbation of heart failure symptoms.

Problem List
Chronic systolic heart failure (HFrEF).

Plan
Continue current medications. Increase furosemide to 80 mg daily for the next week to manage congestion. Patient educated on increased sodium restriction and daily weight monitoring. Follow up in one week, or sooner if symptoms worsen.
explanations: Heart failure appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
